`requirements.md` has been generated for run `20261105-100510-docs-catalog-model-tsdoc` at `.sdlc/runs/20261105-100510-docs-catalog-model-tsdoc/requirements.md`.

### Summary of Requirements
- **Scope**: 45 undocumented public exports in `@backstage/catalog-model` across 15 source files (`conditions.ts`, `KubernetesValidatorFunctions.ts`, 5 `*EntityPolicy.ts` files, and 8 `*EntityV1alpha1.ts` files), regeneration of `report.api.md` and `report-alpha.api.md` via `yarn build:api-reports`, and a single `patch` changeset `.changeset/<new>.md`.
- **Non-Functional Constraints**: Comments-only changes matching existing `@backstage/catalog-model` TSDoc style, strict accuracy against implementation/schemas, preserved copyright headers/years, Prettier on changed files only, and adopter-facing changeset prose.
- **Verification**: Gate 0 command (`yarn build:api-reports && ! grep -q "(undocumented)" packages/catalog-model/report.api.md`), `yarn tsc`, `CI=1 yarn test packages/catalog-model`, and strict write-contract allowlist enforcement (reporting, not writing, any incidental report changes outside `packages/catalog-model`).
